cost.canonicalSource: existing Candidate A and LONG integration cost contract

execution.entry: first saved regular-session 5m OPEN at or after selector decision plus intended delay; missing first eligible bar fails closed; no same-bar future HIGH/LOW
execution.fixedHorizonAnchor: selector decision wall clock; exact completed close; same AM/PM continuous session; positive holding interval required
execution.sessionEnd: same date final regular 5m CLOSE: 15:00 before 2024-11-05, 15:30 thereafter; no auction repair; actual regular bars only across lunch
execution.zero: gross reference 0 at decision, no economic trade/PF/net inference
execution.missing: no fill, no interpolation, no zero imputation; full path must contain every expected regular 5m slot; sparse observed-minute bars accepted as existing reference marks and counted
execution.timing: minutes from decision; first matching 5m bar interval [start,end]; endpoint is a 5m upper bound, never precise first-hit time; lunch is elapsed wall time not trading time
execution.excursions: gross relative to immediate OPEN, MFE=max(0,high return), MAE=min(0,low return); earliest tied bar; zero excursion has timing null

cohorts.primary: COMMON120: per-arm identical row IDs complete at all fixed positive horizons <=120; pair comparison then retains timestamps with all original Top5 complete in BOTH arms; no replacement
cohorts.secondary: COMMON60 and COMMON90 same rule; AVAILABLE is horizon-specific and descriptive only; SESSION_END separate
cohorts.armStandalone: all complete rows in the given arm, with manifest hashes and counts; do not subtract standalone means and call it matched advantage
cohorts.coverage: report eligible/evaluable rows, full5 matched timestamps, missing reasons and sessions; show strict matching attrition; no minimum-N tuning

statistics.pointEstimate: session-equal primary and row-weighted descriptive; paired timestamp Top5 means then session means
statistics.mde: (1.959963984540054+0.8416212335729143)*SD(session means)/sqrt(cluster count); normal approximation, 80% power, two-sided 5%
statistics.multiplicity: pointwise 95% descriptive CIs; primary family across 7 COMMON120 Selector-Random net contrasts also simultaneous Bonferroni 95% bootstrap intervals; no isolated p-value verdict

metrics.winnerCondition: reached threshold anywhere through SESSION_END on a completely observed path; terminal at each horizon separately; future-conditioned description only
metrics.peakAfterEndpoint: full-day peak minus earlier endpoint is NOT post-peak giveback; post-peak giveback only when peak bar end <= endpoint
metrics.tailExclusion: ceil(fraction*all evaluable rows) largest strictly positive net rows, capped at positive count; worst tail analogous negative; fractions 0.01,0.05; tie break event ID; report removed contribution and remaining mean
metrics.moments: population skewness and excess kurtosis; outlier sensitive; null if variance=0
metrics.concentration: symbol selection frequency HHI; exclude three most frequent symbols descriptively, no rerank; session top/bottom5 contribution

stratification.volatility: decisionVolatilityPct cross-sectional average percentile rank among eligible universe at same timestamp: <=1/3 LOW, <=2/3 MID, else HIGH; missing UNKNOWN
stratification.scoreDecile: PIT savedV1Score average percentile rank among same timestamp eligible universe; ceil(10*rank), 1..10; no future-dependent bin boundaries
stratification.tick: actual dated tick NOT_EVALUABLE; 1JPY/price and ceil(price*threshold/100) nominal increments only; never claim exchange ticks

scoreAnalysis.source: exact deterministic existing corrected Development reconstruction and frozen weights; no fit
scoreAnalysis.deciles: full eligible universe PIT score ranks before outcome availability
scoreAnalysis.rankIC: per-timestamp Spearman against terminal gross, MFE, abs(MAE); session-cluster mean IC; constant vector NOT_EVALUABLE
scoreAnalysis.universePersistence: aggregate diagnostics only; private intermediate rows purged

primaryQuestions: MFE uplift vs absolute MAE uplift

verdictRules.directional: multiple COMMON120 horizons positive paired terminal lower simultaneous CI, >=38 clusters, positive excursion balance difference; tail and price robustness must be reviewed; relative information separate from absolute net
verdictRules.delayed: COMMON120 paired net advantage at120 minus30 has pointwise lower CI>0; late advantage lower simultaneous CI>0; >=38 clusters
verdictRules.shortLived: early (5/10/15/30) paired lower simultaneous CI>0 and120 minus30 upper CI<0 with increasing giveback
verdictRules.range: positive MFE and absMAE uplifts with weak terminal evidence; score association is supporting description, no causal claim
verdictRules.tail: full net mean positive but both top1 and top5 excluded means nonpositive, descriptive tag
verdictRules.otherwise: MIXED or INCONCLUSIVE; wide late CI is DELAYED_ALPHA_INCONCLUSIVE, not no alpha; all verdicts diagnostic only
